title: Console list query and filter builder do not read a stored view filter's any-of group
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2fi9zfJhUTubyJYb6V

Filing gate: ② the consumer half of #28020. The spec half adds an any-of group element to the view filter list; the console half is this card. It lands after the spec PR on branch `claude/issue-28020-view-filter-or-group` (the spec PR for #28020), and it stays open until that PR merges.
Seam: `spec:ViewFilterElementSchema / ViewFilterAnyGroupSchema` (`{ any: [rule, ...] }`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) → `renderer:` the console's view filter readers listed below.
Reach: any list view, view tab, page base filter (`interfaceConfig.filterBy`), element data source or component `filter` door whose natural filter is an any-of, such as HotCRM's "open, or completed in the last 7 days" (#27386 row 1). The spec half marks the group `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` in its describe until this card lands.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`.

## The contract (spec half)

A view filter list stays an AND list. One element kind sits beside the flat `{ field, operator, value }` rule: `{ any: [rule, ...] }`, a non-empty array of flat rules of which ANY may match. One level only. `isViewFilterAnyGroup(value)` from `@objectstack/spec/ui` tells the two element kinds apart. Every carrier of the list takes it (`ViewFilterElementSchema`). `ViewFilterRule` (the type) still means one flat rule; a carrier's element type is now `ViewFilterElement`.

## What the console does today (read, not run)

Each reader below handles flat rules only. Read at this repo's `ui/` tree on `origin/main` `22ce3d13fe`; the per-path runtime behaviour on a stored group (a silent drop or a refusal) was not measured.

- Query build: `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (`buildEffectiveFilter`, `convertFilterGroupToAST`), `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts` (`convertFiltersToAST`, `viewFilterRuleToNode`), and `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` (`objectFilterEntriesToAST`, which throws `MalformedFilterError` for an entry with no `field`).
- Save: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts` (`foldFilterGroupToSpecRules`) refuses a builder group with `logic: 'or'` (`or_logic`), because the list had no OR spelling. With the group it can fold an OR group to `[{ any: [rules] }]`.
- Read back into the builder: `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/config/view-config-utils.ts` (`parseSpecFilter`) builds a group from flat rules only.

## Wanted

- The list query (and every other consumer that lowers a view filter list) lowers a group to an `or` node of its rules, inside the list's `and`.
- The filter builder saves an OR group as one group element instead of refusing it, and reads a stored group element back as an OR group.
- When this lands, the spec describe loses its `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker (a one-line spec follow-up), and the liveness note for `list.filter` names the reader.

Dedupe words: view filter any-of group console, plugin-list OR group query, viewFilterFold or_logic.

Related: #28020, #27386 (row 1).

Blocked-by: #28020
